title: Woman with Armillary Sphere
description: A woman with her hair in a bun sits on a stool facing an armillary sphere and an open book. Her right hand touches the book which has a red wax seal and dripping red liquid while torn pages with marks lie on the floor; she holds a tool in her left hand. The setting is inside a room with a large circular stained glass window showing stars and patterns against a twilight sky, surrounded by swirling colorful clouds. The colors are deep blues, golds, reds, and purples.
prompt: A woman with brown hair in a bun wearing a long plaid dress sits on a wooden stool facing left, her right hand touching an open book with a red wax seal and dripping red liquid while her left hand holds a small tool, an armillary sphere with painted markings stands beside the book with torn pages showing marks scattered on the floor, behind her is a large circular stained glass window depicting stars and patterns against a twilight sky, all surrounded by swirling colorful clouds in deep blues golds reds and purples, fantasy style oil painting
